# Synthetic case fixture

All people, companies, events, amounts, and documents in this directory are fictional. They may be sent to the configured public model API during development and demonstration.

The fixture intentionally contains four labeled conflicts:

1. date: 2021-06-01 versus 2021-03-05;
2. amount: CNY 500,000 versus CNY 450,000;
3. action presence: payment received versus transaction failed/not received;
4. subject/person: payer Wang Hai versus payer Chen Jun.

The scanned PDF has no text layer and exists to test OCR and page provenance.
